The theorem in `/work/putnam_2004_a4.lean` is now proved. The file compiles with no errors and no "declaration uses `sorry`" warning. The imports, statement, and file name are unchanged, and the only edit is replacing `sorry` with the proof. The file uses no axioms, `sorry`, `admit`, `native_decide`, `#eval`, or metaprogramming.

**Proof idea.** The identity is the multilinear polarization formula

  ∑_{ε ∈ {±1}ⁿ} (∏ᵢ εᵢ) · (∑ᵢ εᵢ xᵢ)ⁿ = 2ⁿ · n! · ∏ᵢ xᵢ.

It uses N = 2ⁿ sign vectors, with c_ε = (∏ εᵢ) / (2ⁿ · n!) and a_{ε,j} = εⱼ. The proof expands (∑ εᵢxᵢ)ⁿ as a sum over functions f : Fin n → Fin n. Summing over ε then forces every fibre of f to have odd size. With n points that happens only when f is a bijection, and the n! permutations give the factor n!.
